title: ulmus scabra subf. viminalis
intro: Ulmus scabra subf. viminalis, commonly known as Japanese Elm, is a plant species within the Ulmus genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving cough and respiratory issues, and treating skin conditions such as eczema and wounds due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus scabra subf. viminalis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulator. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
